create.name: Justin Michael Williams
create.bio:
Justin Michael Williams works where meditation, music and social change meet. A Grammy-nominated singer and songwriter as well as a meditation teacher, he has spent close to twenty years teaching, and he speaks to companies, universities and festivals about inner work. His first book, Stay Woke (Sounds True, 2020), set out to make meditation feel relevant to people who rarely see themselves in wellness spaces, especially younger readers. With Shelly Tygielski he later wrote How We Ended Racism, which imagines looking back from 2050 at how real equality was reached.

His own method, Freedom Meditation, pairs everyday mindfulness with shadow work, so that people notice the patterns that hold them back and act on what they really want. He teaches it through self-paced audio programmes such as 40 Days to Transformation and the Shadow Work Bootcamp, a monthly membership with live masterclasses and coaching, and an online teacher training that has certified more than 150 meditation teachers across ten countries since 2022. He also hosts music-and-mindfulness retreats in Bali, and his free guided practices and courses on Insight Timer reach a large audience. He is based in Los Angeles.

books.title: Stay Woke: A Meditation Guide for the Rest of Us
books.author: Justin Michael Williams
books.description: A friendly, down-to-earth introduction to meditation for readers who have felt left out of the wellness world. Williams draws on his own story to help readers build a short daily practice that suits real, busy lives.

books.title: How We Ended Racism: Realizing a New Possibility in One Generation
books.author: Justin Michael Williams, Shelly Tygielski
books.description: Written with Shelly Tygielski, this book imagines the year 2050 and traces backwards how a society free of racism came about. It pairs inner reflection with practical community steps readers can begin now.

courses.title: Transform My Life Membership
courses.description: A monthly online membership with a new live masterclass each month, his full library of guided meditations, live question-and-answer sessions and group rooms with coaches he has trained. It also includes full access to the 40 Days programme.

courses.title: 40 Days to Transformation
courses.description: A self-paced programme of short daily audio practices grouped into weekly themes. It moves from getting clear on a personal vision to spotting self-sabotage and building a steady daily ritual.

courses.title: Shadow Work Bootcamp
courses.description: A nine-part self-guided audio course on recognising the hidden parts of ourselves that quietly undermine our choices. Each practice lasts around a quarter of an hour and can be taken daily or at your own pace.

courses.title: Online Meditation Teacher Training Certification
courses.description: A cohort-based online certification in which trainees learn to practise and teach his Freedom Meditation method alongside shadow work, with guidance on building a teaching practice. Entry is by application and the next cohort has a waitlist.

courses.title: Justin Michael Williams Masterclasses
courses.description: Two-hour classes recorded live, available on demand, on themes such as authenticity, boundaries and working with your shadow. Each can be bought singly, and members of his monthly membership get them included.

courses.title: Renew Retreat 2027 Bali: A Music & Mindfulness Experience
courses.description: A seven-night residential retreat at Soulshine in Bali, combining daily meditation, shadow work, ritual, morning movement and live music with cultural visits. Shared and private room options are offered with payment plans.

courses.title: 10 Steps To Radical Change
courses.description: A ten-day Insight Timer course of short daily sessions that moves from inner work, such as easing self-criticism and perfectionism, to outward action in your community. It closes with writing a personal mantra for the change you want to make.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: 40 Days To Manifestation
courses.description: A forty-day Insight Timer course of brief daily sessions on getting clear about what you want, noticing the patterns that block it and shaping a meditation routine that lasts.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

free_resources.title: Justin Michael Williams on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: His Insight Timer page holds guided meditations, short talks and music-led practices on self-worth, intention and everyday mindfulness. The tracks are free to listen to in the app or on the web.
